nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced; at 5.00 seconds, <Picture 2> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] One uninterrupted cinematic close-up inside a car on a rainy night. Begin exactly with Picture 1: the woman sits on the left, gazing through the rain-covered window; warm amber and red city lights glow beyond the glass, and a prominent droplet hangs near the top of the window. The camera makes a very slow, steady push toward her face without changing the overall composition. The droplet begins to slide naturally down the glass, leaving a thin wet trail. Smaller droplets merge and creep downward at different speeds. She blinks once, slowly turns her face away from the window, and meets the camera with a quiet, faint smile. Passing city light gently shifts the warm highlights on her cheek while cool blue light remains along the edge of her hair. Her short brown bob, bangs, facial features, black high collar, gold brooch, embroidered coat, and butterfly-shaped shoulder detail remain consistent. End exactly on Picture 2, with the principal droplet lower on the window and her gaze directed toward the camera. Keep her face in focus and the city lights softly blurred. No cuts, transitions, sudden zooms, speech, or new people.
overall_soundscape:
Soft rain tapping the car window, a subdued car-cabin hum, and distant muted traffic. No dialogue.
non_diegetic_music:
N/A
